Our Approach

Private Pet Care for
Orange County Families

When you're away from home, your pets shouldn't have to feel like their routine has been put on hold. I provide private, in-home pet care for Orange County families who want more than a quick visit or a standard sitting service, with the goal of keeping your pets safe, comfortable, and loved in the environment they already know.

With more than four years of hands-on pet hospitality experience, I understand that every pet is different. Some need long walks and plenty of exercise. Others need medication, extra patience, or simply someone who understands their personality. I take the time to learn your pet's routine and follow it closely, because consistency matters most while you're away.

About Me

A Trusted Hand
in Your Home

Hi there! I bring years of hands-on experience caring for dogs of all ages, sizes, and needs, including my own husky and several senior dogs requiring medical support and veterinary visits.

Pet care isn't just about completing a checklist to me. It's about knowing the animal. Some dogs want to run until they're worn out. Some want to stay close to you. Some need medication at a very specific time. I try to understand those differences before I ever begin caring for a pet.

Throughout my life I've owned and loved five dogs. I understand the importance of treating every pet like family and providing care that matches their normal routine.

Beyond pet care, I've also been trusted to look after luxury homes throughout Coto de Caza, Dove Canyon, Ladera Ranch, Irvine, and Newport. For over four years I managed weekly household needs while coordinating with maids, landscapers, pool services, and other vendors.

Whether it's keeping up with energetic dogs, providing extra care for senior pets, or making sure your home remains secure while you're away, you can count on me to handle everything with reliability and professionalism.

In Person

Meet Your Sitter

Hi, I'm Brandon, your local pet care professional. That's my husky, Zeus, who's been by my side through all of it.

I've spent much of my life around dogs and understand how deeply they become part of a family. When you book with me, you're not handing your pet off to a stranger. You're getting someone who genuinely loves this, shows up on time, and treats your home and your pet the way I'd want mine treated.

My Promise

No Request Is Too Big

One client came to me because her dog needed more than a quick walk around the block. She needed someone who could run and walk him two to five miles a day, rain or shine, while she was at work. She wasn't just looking for someone to let her dog outside. She wanted him to keep living his best life, full of energy, even when she couldn't be the one out there with him.

That's the standard I hold every request to. Whatever your pet needs, whether it's long runs, multiple daily visits, a strict medication schedule, or extra reassurance for a senior dog, I'll build the plan around them, not the other way around.

Your pet doesn't need to fit into my routine. I'll build the routine around your pet.

No request is too big.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I get started?

Reach out and tell me a little about your pet, your schedule, and the kind of care you're looking for. From there we'll set up a free meet and greet before anything is booked.

What if my travel plans change?

Plans shift, and that's okay. Reach out as soon as you know and I'll do my best to adjust the schedule with you.

Do I need to provide a key?

We'll coordinate whatever access works best and feels most secure for you and your home.

What areas do you serve?

Throughout South Orange County, including Coto de Caza, Newport Coast, Irvine, and the surrounding communities listed above. Boat and airfare travel is available upon request.
